Using these data we investigated the relation between vegetation structure, land use and the diversity of species and traits in butterflies for the Netherlands. The research paper, now accepted for publication but not yet online, in the journal "Global Ecology and Biogeography", has the title "Butterflies show different functional and species diversity in relation to vegetation structure and land-use".
